verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents its own capability to assign an operator to a call queued in a contact center, which partly covers conversation assignment within a team-shared queue. Nothing in the evidence shows a shared number for teammates, presence indicators, or internal threads. missing for 10: shared-number inbox for multiple teammates, presence/availability visibility, internal threads or notes on conversations, assignment for messaging conversations rather than only queued calls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: Assigns an operator to a call queued in a contact center. Only contact center calls are eligible for this operation.
